name: Local Voting Isomorphism
description: Replaced the global connectivity/spanning requirement with a strictly local voting rule evaluated per-edge. Instead of asking to connect all key nodes (which trivially maps to Steiner tree), the problem defines an edge as 'contested' if key nodes are strictly closer to different endpoints of the edge. This is mathematically isomorphic to the edge being in the Steiner tree, but masks the global tree-pruning structure behind a local shortest-path narrative. Models that simulate the local rule will TLE (O(n^2)), while models that recognize the structural equivalence to components in a tree will use DFS and pass (O(n)).
